tasks.title: AI-rule precision + generated-content detection (top-25 scan)
tasks.description: Fixes surfaced scanning the top 26 public MCP servers: AI-033 pattern bug (matched bare null/false/disabled -> 6300 FPs on TS type defs), AI-036 pattern bug (bare '35'), AI-026 over-broad logging, test/doc ignore for AI-006/008/026/036/039, and content-based generated/minified detection in the AI analyzer (banner + long-line) to catch generated bundles embedded in normal extensions. Validated: cloudflare AI-033 ->0, mongodb 38->6, top-26 corpus 0 true positives / 0 disclosure. Documented in CHANGELOG.

tasks.title: Triage history learning and persistence
tasks.description: Implement .nox/triage-history.json for persisting user-confirmed triage decisions. When a user confirms or overrides a triage verdict, store the finding fingerprint, verdict, and context hash. Use historical data to improve LLM prompts with few-shot examples of similar past decisions. Include import/export for team sharing.

tasks.title: Implement MCP plugin bridge
tasks.description: Extend MCP server with plugin tools: plugin.list (enumerate installed plugins and their capabilities), plugin.call_tool (invoke a specific plugin tool with arguments, returning results), plugin.read_resource (read plugin-provided resources). Support convenience aliases mapping friendly names to plugin tools (e.g., nox.dast.scan). Inherit workspace allowlisting and output size limits. Package: server/plugins.

tasks.title: Add staged-files-only scan mode
tasks.description: Add --staged flag to 'nox scan' that scans only git staged files (git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR). Used by the pre-commit hook for fast scanning. Only reads and scans the staged versions of files. Integrates with existing discovery and analyzer pipeline.

tasks.title: Implement CLI scaffold with scan command
tasks.description: CLI entry point using cobra or similar. 'nox scan <path>' command wiring discovery -> analyzers -> reporters. Output format flag (--format sarif,cdx,spdx,json,all). Exit codes (0=clean, 1=findings, 2=error). Quiet/verbose flags. Config file loading (.nox.yaml). Package: cli.

tasks.title: K8s plugin binary with dynamic-runtime track conformance
tasks.description: Create K8s plugin using SDK on dynamic-runtime track with RiskActive, needs_confirmation=true, and network_hosts=[kubernetes API]. Wire up API client, security checks, and drift detection. Add conformance tests using RunForTrack(TrackDynamicRuntime). Integration tests with kind (Kubernetes in Docker) for CI.

tasks.title: Implement plugin SDK
tasks.description: Minimal SDK for plugin authors: include versioned protobuf definitions, gRPC server scaffolding (Go), manifest builder helpers, capability declaration utilities, safety envelope parsing, artifact serialization helpers (Finding, SBOM Component, AI Inventory Entry), and a conformance test runner that validates plugin behavior against the contract. Include a 'nox plugin init' template generator. Package: sdk/.

tasks.title: IaC cross-resource plugin binary and conformance tests
tasks.description: Create the IaC cross-resource plugin using the SDK on core-analysis track. Wire up Terraform parsing, graph construction, and cross-resource rule engine. Add conformance tests and integration tests with sample Terraform configurations containing cross-resource misconfigurations.

tasks.title: MCP rule precision hardening (FP reduction)
tasks.description: Reduce false positives in MCP-009..014 and MCP-018/019 surfaced by dogfooding 17 own MCP repos. Concrete fixes: (1) add ignoreFilePatterns for test files (*_test.go, *_test.py, *.test.ts/js, *.spec.ts) to the noisy prose rules; (2) avoid matching inside line/block comments (engine-level comment awareness or per-rule anchoring); (3) MCP-018 must not fire when a metadata IP appears in a block/deny/blocklist context; (4) anchor MCP-009/010/011/013/014 to a tool-description/string-literal context rather than free source prose. Re-run the 17-repo dogfood corpus and confirm the high-interest counts drop to genuine signal. Mirror the AI-028 fuzz-corpus FP-reduction test pattern. Gate before publishing dogfood findings.

tasks.title: Implement canonical findings model
tasks.description: Define Finding struct with ID, rule ID, severity, confidence, location (file/region/line/column), message. Implement deterministic fingerprinting (SHA-256 hash of rule+location+content). Implement deduplication by fingerprint. Ensure SARIF-compatible location model. Package: core/findings.

tasks.title: Implement dependency scanner
tasks.description: Parse lockfiles: npm package-lock.json, Go go.sum, Python requirements.txt/poetry.lock, Ruby Gemfile.lock. Extract package name/version/ecosystem. OSV API client for vulnerability lookup (offline-graceful). Produce CycloneDX component entries. Package: core/analyzers/deps.

tasks.title: Go call graph construction with go/callgraph
tasks.description: Build Go call graph extraction using go/callgraph (CHA or RTA algorithm). Parse Go modules, resolve function calls across packages, and output Graph with NodeKindFunction nodes and EdgeKindCalls edges. Include test fixtures with known call chains.

tasks.title: Implement JSON findings output
tasks.description: Serialize findings to canonical findings.json with deterministic key ordering. Include schema version field. Package: core/report.

tasks.title: K8s runtime security checks
tasks.description: Implement runtime-specific checks: containers running as root, privileged containers, host PID/network/IPC namespace, mounted secrets in env vars, missing network policies, missing resource limits, latest/unpinned image tags, host path mounts, capabilities not dropped. Emit findings with precise workload/container location.

tasks.title: AI triage conformance tests and integration tests
tasks.description: Write conformance tests using RunForTrack(TrackAgentAssistance). Add integration tests with mock LLM responses verifying enrichment output structure. Test offline fallback behavior when no LLM is configured.

tasks.title: MCP09 shadow-server and cross-server shadowing rules
tasks.description: Detect rogue/shadow MCP servers and tool-name shadowing: configs trusting unverified/unpinned remote servers, missing server allowlisting, and a tool name redefined across servers enabling override/escalation. Operates over the multi-client config inventory. New rules MCP-022..MCP-024. Tests for shadowing across two server configs and for unpinned-remote trust.

tasks.title: Bidirectional proto conversion for Graph, Enrichment, ScanContext
tasks.description: Add ProtoGraphToGo, GoGraphToProto, ProtoEnrichmentToGo, GoEnrichmentToProto, GoScanResultToProtoContext, and enum converters to plugin/convert.go. Include roundtrip tests and nil-safety tests in convert_test.go.

tasks.title: Implement YAML rule engine with matchers
tasks.description: YAML rule parser/loader with versioned rule ID scheme. Pluggable matcher interface with regex, jsonpath, yamlpath, and heuristic implementations. Rule validation and test harness. No embedded code execution. Package: core/rules.

tasks.title: Implement IaC security rules
tasks.description: YAML rule definitions for Dockerfile best practices (no root user, pinned base images), Terraform security (public access, encryption at rest), Kubernetes manifests (privilege escalation, host network). Package: rules/iac/.

tasks.title: Zero-telemetry offline guarantee and positioning
tasks.description: Add an enforced offline guarantee: a CI/test gate asserting the core scan path makes zero outbound network calls (dialer hook that fails the test on any connection), plus a --offline assertion flag. Update README and docs with the vendor-neutral, no-telemetry positioning vs commercial scanners. The verifiable engineering (network-assertion test, flag) is the deliverable; messaging accompanies.

tasks.title: SDK: GraphBuilder, EnrichmentBuilder, ToolWithContext, ToolRequest, type constants
tasks.description: Add fluent GraphBuilder (Node, NodeAt, Edge, EdgeLabeled, Done) and EnrichmentBuilder (Body, WithMetadata, WithConfidence, Source, Done) to sdk/response.go. Add ToolWithContext() to sdk/manifest.go. Add NodeKind/EdgeKind/Confidence constants to sdk/types.go. Add ToolRequest helper to sdk/request.go. Include tests for all builders and helpers.

tasks.title: Initialize Go module and directory structure
tasks.description: Create Go module (go.mod), set up /core, /cli, /server, /ai-assist package directories with placeholder files, configure golangci-lint (.golangci.yml), and create Makefile with build/test/lint/run targets.

tasks.title: OWASP MCP Top 10 + MCP-38 + spec compliance mapping
tasks.description: Map every MCP and AI rule to OWASP MCP Top 10 (MCP01-10), MCP-38 categories, and official spec clauses in core/compliance data. Add framework entry 'owasp-mcp-top-10'. Emit control IDs as SARIF rule tags/properties so GitHub Code Scanning and registries see standards alignment. Tests asserting each MCP-0xx rule carries a mapped control.

tasks.title: Implement plugin registry client
tasks.description: Registry client that fetches and parses static registry index files from configured URLs. Support multiple registry sources (official, community, enterprise). Implement version resolution with semver constraints and API compatibility checks. Local metadata caching with TTL-based refresh. Offline-friendly: work from cache when network unavailable. Package: core/plugins/registry.

tasks.title: Fixer AI-LOG-001 sensitive logging redaction
tasks.description: Implement AI-LOG-001 fixer to replace raw prompt/response logging with redacted metadata-safe logging helpers for Go, Python, and JS patterns. Add fixture matrix and negative tests for already-safe logging.

tasks.title: Proto schema: Add Graph, Enrichment, ScanContext messages to types.proto and plugin.proto
tasks.description: Add NodeKind/EdgeKind enums, GraphNode/GraphEdge/Graph/Enrichment/ScanContext messages to types.proto. Add scan_context field to InvokeToolRequest, graphs/enrichments to InvokeToolResponse, requires_scan_context to ToolDef in plugin.proto. Generate code with buf generate.

tasks.title: Implement SARIF 2.1.0 report generator
tasks.description: Convert findings to SARIF 2.1.0 JSON. One run per scan. Populate rule catalog from matched rules. Attach fingerprints to results. Validate against GitHub Code Scanning ingestion requirements. Package: core/report/sarif.

tasks.title: Implement Shannon entropy matcher
tasks.description: Add EntropyMatcher to core/rules/matcher.go implementing the Matcher interface. Calculate Shannon entropy for candidate strings extracted via configurable tokenization (quoted strings, assignment RHS values, base64 blobs, hex sequences). Register as 'entropy' matcher type in MatcherRegistry. Support per-rule entropy thresholds via Rule.Metadata. Include context-aware scoring: boost confidence when variable name suggests a secret (password, key, token, secret).

tasks.title: Pursue trusted-catalog embedding
tasks.description: Pursue embedding Nox as the security scanner in a trusted distribution layer (Docker MCP Catalog security tier or a downstream MCP registry security check). Produce the integration artifacts (action manifest, SARIF contract, signed Docker image entry) and outreach materials needed to land the embed.

tasks.title: Implement OCI artifact distribution
tasks.description: Download plugins as OCI artifacts: pull from OCI registries, verify content digests, cache locally with content-addressable storage, support platform-specific binaries, extract plugin manifest and documentation from artifact layers. Support mirror configuration for air-gapped environments. Package: core/plugins/oci.

tasks.title: Implement nox protect command with hook installer
tasks.description: Add 'nox protect install' and 'nox protect uninstall' CLI commands. Generate .git/hooks/pre-commit that runs 'nox scan' on staged files only (git diff --cached --name-only). Add .pre-commit-hooks.yaml for pre-commit framework integration. Support --severity-threshold flag (default: high) to control which findings block commits. Clear output showing rule ID, file, line, and how to suppress with nox:ignore.

tasks.title: Policy model with blast-radius and merge gates
tasks.description: Implement remediation policy parser and validator (plugin config section in `.nox.yaml`) including blast radius thresholds, auto-merge gates, severity filters, major-version behavior, and verification command allowlists. Emit clear validation errors for invalid policy combinations.

tasks.title: Dogfood across own projects and scan-before-publish workflow
tasks.description: Run Nox MCP scanning across the owner's projects (Obvia, agent-go, Mnemos, Chronos, Praxis, statekit, Relicta), triage findings, and publish results as credibility content. Ship a one-command 'scan-before-publish' MCP workflow and an MCP-focused GitHub Action variant with SARIF upload.

tasks.title: MCP rug-pull tool-hash pinning and drift detection
tasks.description: Persist a hash of each discovered MCP tool's description+schema to .nox/ state on first observation (reuse atomic-write content-hash infra in cache.go/state.go). On subsequent scans, flag tools whose definition changed after approval (OWASP MCP04 rug pull). Emit findings with before/after hashes and a new rule MCP-015. Fully offline, deterministic. Include drift + no-drift + first-run tests.

tasks.title: Implement plugin host runtime
tasks.description: Core plugin runtime: discover plugin endpoints (local binary via exec, container via docker, remote gRPC address), call GetManifest on startup, validate manifest against host policy, manage plugin lifecycle (init/invoke/shutdown with graceful timeout), merge plugin-produced findings and SBOM components into Nox's unified ScanResult. Support parallel plugin execution with configurable concurrency. Package: core/plugins/host.

tasks.title: Implement MCP server
tasks.description: MCP server using mcp-go with stdio transport. Read-only tools: scan, get-findings, get-sbom. Workspace allowlisting configuration. Artifact serving via MCP resources. Output size limits and rate limiting. Package: server.

tasks.title: Implement git history commit walker
tasks.description: Add CommitWalker to core/git/ that traverses commit history using git rev-list and git diff-tree. Extract added/modified content per commit as (commitSHA, filePath, content) tuples. Support depth limits, branch selection, and bookmark-based incremental scanning. Return commit metadata (SHA, author, date, message) with each result.

tasks.title: Configure GitHub Actions CI workflow
tasks.description: Set up .github/workflows/ci.yml with Go build, test, lint steps. Trigger on push/PR to main.

tasks.title: Remediation plugin foundations and tool scaffolding
tasks.description: Create `nox-plugin-remediate` scaffolding with tool routing for `remediate.plan_code`, `remediate.apply_code`, and `remediate.verify_code`. Add deterministic patch engine interfaces, idempotence checks, bounded change guardrails (max files/LOC), and rollback-on-verify-failure plumbing. Include fixture harness layout under plugin testdata.

tasks.title: Terraform resource relationship model
tasks.description: Extend tfplan.go and Terraform HCL parsing to build a resource dependency graph. Parse resource references (e.g., aws_subnet.vpc_id → aws_vpc.id), data source dependencies, and module relationships. Output Graph with NodeKindResource nodes and EdgeKindDependsOn/EdgeKindReferences edges.

tasks.title: Cross-resource rule engine with graph pattern matching
tasks.description: Implement declarative cross-resource rules as graph patterns (subgraph matching). Rules define a pattern of nodes and edges that indicate a misconfiguration. Initial rules: public subnet + no NACL + open SG, S3 bucket + no encryption + public ACL, RDS + public subnet + no encryption, EC2 + public IP + permissive SG. Emit findings with multi-resource locations.

tasks.title: Reachability plugin conformance tests and integration tests
tasks.description: Write conformance tests using RunForTrack(TrackCoreAnalysis). Add integration tests with sample Go/Python/JS projects containing known reachable and unreachable vulnerable dependencies. Verify enrichment output accuracy.

tasks.title: K8s drift detection: runtime vs IaC comparison
tasks.description: Compare running workload configuration against IaC definitions (Kubernetes YAML manifests). Detect drift: configuration values that differ between declared and running state. Emit Enrichments linking runtime findings to existing IaC findings. Emit Graph with NodeKindService nodes representing cluster topology and EdgeKindReferences edges to IaC resources.

tasks.title: Fixer WEB-SEC-001 header middleware insertion
tasks.description: Implement first deterministic fixer WEB-SEC-001 for missing baseline security headers middleware in supported Go and Node HTTP stacks. Ensure no duplicate middleware injection. Add before/after fixtures and idempotence tests.

tasks.title: Taint analysis plugin binary and conformance tests
tasks.description: Create taint analysis plugin using SDK on core-analysis track. Wire up taint engine, produce findings with full source→intermediate→sink paths in metadata. Add conformance tests and integration tests with known taint flows (SQL injection, command injection, XSS patterns) across multiple files.

tasks.title: Reachability plugin: ScanContext integration and enrichment output
tasks.description: Create the reachability plugin binary using the SDK. Consume ScanContext to get dependency findings, cross-reference with call graph to determine if vulnerable functions are reachable. Emit Enrichments with kind=reachability on each dependency finding (reachable/unreachable verdict, call path in metadata). Register on core-analysis track with requires_scan_context=true.

tasks.title: MCP07 authorization and token-safety rules
tasks.description: Add rules anchored to the official MCP spec security MUST/SHOULD clauses: token passthrough (server accepts tokens not issued to it), confused-deputy OAuth proxy (static client id + dynamic registration), SSRF in OAuth metadata discovery (169.254.169.254, private CIDRs, DNS-rebinding/redirect chains), and weak session handling (deterministic session ids, sessions-as-auth, missing user binding). New rules MCP-016..MCP-021 with spec-section citations in remediation. Tests with positive/negative configs.

tasks.title: Dataflow tracking engine with cross-file taint propagation
tasks.description: Build taint propagation engine that tracks data flow across function calls, assignments, and file boundaries using tree-sitter ASTs. Handle common patterns: variable assignment, function arguments/returns, string concatenation, format strings. Track taint through intermediate variables. Output Graph with EdgeKindFlowsTo edges representing taint paths.

tasks.title: Conformance: Graph and Enrichment validation, track options
tasks.description: Extend validateResponse() in sdk/conformance.go to validate graph node IDs, edge endpoint references, enrichment fingerprints and kinds. Add WithRequireGraphs and WithRequireEnrichments track conformance options. Add conformance tests exercising graphs and enrichments.

tasks.title: Tool-poisoning test corpus and fixtures
tasks.description: Build a positive/negative fixture corpus for the MCP03 analyzer: known tool-poisoning payloads (unicode evasion, instruction override, exfil), plus benign descriptions that must not false-positive. Table-driven tests for each MCP-009..MCP-014 rule. Confirm determinism and offline operation.

tasks.title: Kubernetes API client and resource discovery
tasks.description: Build Kubernetes API client using client-go. Discover running workloads: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Pods, Services, NetworkPolicies, ConfigMaps, Secrets. Extract security-relevant configuration: securityContext, volumes, env vars, resource limits, image tags. Support KUBECONFIG and in-cluster auth.

tasks.title: Implement CycloneDX and SPDX SBOM generators
tasks.description: Generate sbom.cdx.json (CycloneDX JSON) and sbom.spdx.json (SPDX JSON) from dependency scanner component inventory. Optional vulnerability enrichment via OSV data. Package: core/report/sbom.

tasks.title: Tree-sitter AST parsing for Python/JS/TS call graphs
tasks.description: Integrate tree-sitter grammars for Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Extract function definitions and call sites from AST. Build cross-file call graph by resolving imports. Output Graph with NodeKindFunction nodes and EdgeKindCalls edges.

tasks.title: Implement agent assist module
tasks.description: Optional module using agent-go. Consumes findings + AI inventory. Produces human-readable explanations via LLM. No side effects, never affects scan results. Opt-in activation flag. Separate Go module boundary. Package: ai-assist.

tasks.title: Fixers SEC-002 and SEC-001 with full verification gates
tasks.description: Implement SEC-002 SQL parameterization fixer and SEC-001 subprocess hardening fixer with conservative skip behavior for ambiguous cases. Add strict verification pipeline: targeted tests, lint/typecheck, mandatory re-scan evidence, deterministic and idempotence assertions, and rollback on failed verification.

tasks.title: Taint source and sink definitions for Go/Python/JS
tasks.description: Define taint sources (HTTP request params, env vars, file reads, user input, CLI args) and sinks (SQL queries, shell exec, eval, file write, HTTP response body, template rendering) for Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript. Implement as configurable YAML definitions.

tasks.title: Implement trust and verification
tasks.description: Plugin trust system: validate artifact signatures against configurable trust roots, verify content digests on download and before execution, check API version compatibility, run conformance tests as part of install verification. Implement trust levels (verified: signed by known key, community: signed by unknown key, unverified: unsigned) with configurable minimum trust policy. Enterprise mode: mandate verified-only. Package: registry/trust.

tasks.title: Wire custom rules loader to CLI
tasks.description: Add --rules flag to scan, diff, and protect commands that accepts a file or directory path. Load custom YAML rules via existing LoadRulesFromFile/LoadRulesFromDir and merge with built-in rules. Support 'rules_dir' key in .nox.yaml for default custom rules path. Validate rules at load time with clear errors for invalid patterns, missing fields, or duplicate IDs. Add tests for custom rule loading and merging.

tasks.title: AI triage LLM provider abstraction
tasks.description: Build LLM provider abstraction supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama backends. Integrate with existing assist/ module patterns. Implement prompt templates for triage: include finding details, surrounding code context, and severity assessment instructions. Support configurable model selection and temperature.

tasks.title: MCP03 tool-poisoning content analyzer and rules
tasks.description: Add a content analyzer for MCP tool metadata that inspects tool descriptions, input schemas, and tool return-value templates for malicious instructions (OWASP MCP03). Detect: imperative injection phrases ('ignore previous instructions', 'do not tell the user', 'always call'), hidden/zero-width unicode and bidi control chars, exfiltration verbs targeting secrets/files/credentials/env, and instructions aimed at the host model rather than the operator. New rules MCP-009..MCP-014 in core/analyzers/ai/rules.go reusing AI-PI heuristics. Wire into existing mcp.json + claude_desktop_config.json + source tool-registration scanning.

tasks.title: Implement plugin safety engine
tasks.description: Host-side safety enforcement: parse and validate plugin-declared safety requirements against host policy (.nox.yaml), enforce scope allowlists (network hosts/CIDRs, file path globs, env vars), apply rate limits (RPM, bandwidth), enforce concurrency caps, default read-only mode, artifact size limits, redact secrets from plugin outputs, require explicit opt-in for destructive actions. Log violations and terminate non-compliant plugins. Package: core/plugins/safety.

tasks.title: Implement AI security rules and inventory extractor
tasks.description: YAML rules for prompt/RAG boundary violations, unsafe MCP tool exposure, insecure prompt/response logging, unpinned models. AI inventory extractor that produces ai.inventory.json. Package: core/analyzers/ai, rules/ai/.

tasks.title: Define protobuf plugin interface
tasks.description: Define proto/nox/plugin/v1/plugin.proto with PluginService (GetManifest, InvokeTool, StreamArtifacts RPCs), PluginManifest message (name, version, capabilities, safety requirements, API compatibility), ToolInvocation request/response messages, and artifact streaming messages. Generate Go code via buf/protoc. Establish versioning scheme for the plugin API.

tasks.title: Agent capability discovery integration
tasks.description: Integrate plugin capabilities with agent-assist module: advertise available plugin capabilities (dast.passive, cloud.read_only, policy.enforcement, etc.) to agent runtimes, allow agents to discover and invoke plugin tools, summarize plugin results in agent explanations. Agents never influence scan results. Package: ai-assist/plugins.

tasks.title: Host extensions: InvokePostScan, MergeResults, estimateResponseSize
tasks.description: Extend plugin/host.go MergeResults() to handle graphs and enrichments. Add InvokePostScan() for post-scan plugin orchestration with ScanContext. Update estimateResponseSize() for new types. Update PluginInfo/ToolInfo with RequiresScanContext. Add comprehensive tests in host_test.go.

tasks.title: Multi-client MCP config discovery (17+ clients)
tasks.description: Add an MCP client-config registry enumerating config locations for Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Continue, Gemini CLI, Zed, Claude Desktop, and others across macOS/Linux/Windows. Extend core/discovery to resolve and classify these as MCP configs. Add a 'scan machine' entry path that discovers installed MCP servers system-wide. Tests with per-OS path fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement secrets scanner analyzer
tasks.description: Pattern-based analyzer using rule engine for detecting AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, generic high-entropy strings. Configurable entropy threshold. Allowlist/ignore via .nox.yaml. Line-level location reporting into findings model. Package: core/analyzers/secrets.

tasks.title: Implement CLI plugin commands
tasks.description: Add CLI commands: 'nox registry add/list/remove' for registry management, 'nox plugin search/info/install/update/list/remove/call' for plugin lifecycle. Install command performs trust verification, conformance test, and manifest validation. Call command invokes a plugin tool directly from CLI with JSON input/output. Package: cli/plugins.

tasks.title: Fixer SEC-003 hardcoded secret to env/config rewrite
tasks.description: Implement SEC-003 fixer for hardcoded secret literals -> env/config lookup rewrites in supported language idioms. Add guarded fallback behavior and TODO marker options for provisioning. Include compile/runtime smoke verification hooks.

tasks.title: Domain types: core/graph and core/findings/enrichment
tasks.description: Create core/graph/graph.go with NodeKind, EdgeKind, Node, Edge, Graph types and Validate()/NodeIDs() methods. Create core/findings/enrichment.go with Enrichment type. Add Graphs and Enrichments fields to ScanResult in core/scan.go. Include unit tests.

tasks.title: Add entropy-based rules and integrate with secrets analyzer
tasks.description: Define 3-5 entropy rules: high-entropy assignment (SEC-087), high-entropy base64 blob (SEC-088), high-entropy hex string (SEC-089). Add to builtinSecretRules() in core/analyzers/secrets/rules.go. Tune thresholds to minimize false positives (entropy >= 4.5 for assignments, >= 5.0 for standalone strings). Add comprehensive tests with known secrets and known non-secrets (UUIDs, hashes in comments, etc.).

tasks.title: Implement file discovery engine
tasks.description: Recursive directory walker with configurable root path. Gitignore-aware filtering using go-git or similar. Artifact type classification (source, config, lockfile, container, AI component). Extensible classifier registry. Package: core/discovery.

tasks.title: AI triage plugin with ScanContext and enrichment output
tasks.description: Create AI triage plugin on agent-assistance track with requires_scan_context=true. Consume all findings from ScanContext, batch findings by file for context efficiency, call LLM for each finding/batch. Emit Enrichments with kind=triage carrying verdict (true_positive/false_positive/needs_review), adjusted severity, confidence, and markdown explanation. Implement rate limiting and cost controls.

tasks.title: Integrate history scanning into secrets analyzer and CLI
tasks.description: Add HistoryScan mode to the secrets analyzer that consumes CommitWalker output and runs all 86 rules against historical diffs. Enrich findings with commit SHA, author, and date in Metadata. Add --history flag to 'nox scan' CLI with --history-depth and --history-branch options. Add HistoryFinding fields to the findings model. Update SARIF reporter to include commit metadata in result properties.
